title: Flux tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Flux domain (Battleground Bible §4, §5, §9, §10, §18; ADR-011 §10): what each source of Team Flux grants, and how active Team Flux strengthens a team's lane Fluxborn. VeyraFlux binds it to FVeyraFluxTuning.

grant.description: What one source grants the team that secured it.

duration.description: Permanent Flux never expires; temporary Flux expires on its own timer, independently of every other grant (Battleground Bible §10).

durationSeconds.description: How long a temporary grant lasts, in seconds; 0 for a permanent one.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

grants.description: Team Flux from destroyed enemy structures and secured Flux Wells (Battleground Bible §6).

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Battleground Bible §5, §10 and §18 give them at current prototype tuning.

laneSpire.description: A destroyed lane Spire: +25 permanent (Battleground Bible §5).

baseTower.description: A destroyed base-defense tower: the same as a lane Spire (Battleground Bible §18).

inhibitor.description: A destroyed inhibitor: +25 temporary for 3 minutes (Battleground Bible §10).

fluxWell.description: A secured Flux Well (§6: +50 temporary for 3 minutes).

fluxbornScaling.description: Every full step of active Team Flux strengthens all of the team's lane Fluxborn on every lane (Battleground Bible §4). Temporary Flux counts while it lasts.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Battleground Bible §4 gives the current prototype scaling.

healthPerStep.description: Max Health added per step, as a fraction of the Fluxborn's own; 0.05 is 5%.

damagePerStep.description: Damage added per step, as a fraction; 0.05 is 5%.

spellSlots.description: The permanent Team Flux that unlocks each Flux Spell slot, in slot order (Battleground Bible §14; ADR-015 §4). Temporary Flux never counts.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Battleground Bible §14 gives the current prototype thresholds.
